Callout.Name: Money Truck Theft
Callout.Message: Armoured truck being broken into, guards held.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects, both armed, truck stopped.

Script.Line: They have the crew locked in the back of the truck.
Three of them, and they came in a van with no plates.
They are still at it. They have not gone yet.

Lines.Approach: They have stopped the truck and they are working on the back of it. Two, both armed.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
